name: code-snippet-image
description: Turn code into clean images for slides, docs and posts: syntax highlighting for TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, Go, Rust, Java, C/C++, SQL, shell, CSS, HTML, JSON and YAML, six themes, line numbers, highlighted lines, a macOS-style window and a gradient background. Cut any line range out of a file (several snippets per file), common indentation is removed and long lines wrap. Before you share, it warns about API keys, tokens, private keys, hard-coded passwords and URLs with credentials in the snippet, and can mask them in the image. Exports a PNG (at 2× by default) and an SVG per snippet. Runs locally; no account or API keys.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 把代码做成适合放进幻灯片、文档和帖子的图片：支持 TypeScript/JavaScript、Python、Go、Rust、Java、C/C++、SQL、Shell、CSS、HTML、JSON、YAML 语法高亮，六种主题，带行号、高亮行、macOS 风格窗口和渐变背景。可以从文件里截任意行范围（一个文件可以出多张），自动去掉公共缩进，长行自动折行。分享前会提示代码里的 API 密钥、令牌、私钥、写死的密码和带账号密码的 URL，并可以在图片里打码。每段导出 PNG（默认 2 倍清晰度）和 SVG。在本地运行，不用登录，无需 API 密钥。
